description: Season 1 shop, read live from the chain (not the services board; that is shop_list): Black Market crate, Portal disk and mercenary prices in ETH from the LIVE Games Master v2 sales, with supply left and whether their event is live (they only sell while it runs; the original Season 1 set is retired and shown as a legacy row; gm_flash_info and prepare_gm_flash_mint cover the same sales), and Armory weapons 1 to 12 with ZENI price, Stash rank and supply. Buy with prepare_buy_crate, prepare_buy_portal, prepare_buy_merc, prepare_buy_weapon; Operatives with mint_info / prepare_mint_operative. The Override Disk is Ripples' collection and trades on OpenSea: no route here. Read only.
